correctness.rationale: The C_n edge orbits are the cyclic distances; reflections preserve all orbits. Watkins vertex-connectivity bound gives 3-connectivity for connected circulants having >=2 distances. Unit singletons remain non-three-connected cycles. The resulting gcd complex is covered by prime-indexed simplices whose nerve is the prime-set boundary exactly for squarefree composites; all other cases and isolated units are included. The n=30 homology follows; 6,117 direct double-vertex-deletion checks test the critical classification without serving as general proof.
